engagement.interaction_backstory: A liturgical convert out of a megachurch, he reads every lyric before it enters the house and has a private document of lines he thinks are theologically sloppy. He plays the prayers and the contemplative catalog while his daughter naps. He would subscribe today if the site published its lyrics as text.

depth.core_contradiction: Left the megachurch over emotional manipulation and now manages his own household's feelings with a spreadsheet.
depth.wound: He gave eleven years to a church that measured him in attendance numbers.
depth.longing: A form that holds him without asking him to perform.
depth.faith_journey: Evangelical to twenty-six, then the prayer book; the beauty caught him before the theology did and he is embarrassed by that order.
depth.voice_fingerprint: "Strictly" and "properly speaking"; writes in full paragraphs in text messages.
depth.open_doubt: Whether he found reverence or just found a better aesthetic.

social_graph.note: came with him and misses the old singing
60s; patient with him; not impressed by him

depth.emotional_weather_default: Contained; genuinely undone by the daughter about twice a week.
depth.daily_texture: Drafting until seven, evening prayer at nine, the baby monitor on the desk.
depth.sensory_anchor: A choir singing compline in a stone room, the first time, at twenty-six.
depth.living_arc: Learning that his convictions are becoming a personality and not liking it.
